preconditions.description: The number of town attractions is between 3 and 20, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= matrix[i][j] <= 1000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: All elements in the adjacency matrix are non-negative integers not exceeding 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[j][i] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
all(matrix[i][j] != matrix[i][k] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) for k in range(N) if j != k and j != i and k != i)
postconditions.description: All elements in the adjacency matrix are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(matrix[i][j] for j in range(N) if i != j) == sum(matrix[j][i] for j in range(N) if i != j) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The sum of the costs of the tour roads is the same for every city sightseeing tour.
